description: Bring a file into FynePDF. Shows a drop zone where the app supports it (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code); it takes several files at once, e.g. for a merge, and reports their file_ids in order. With file_name and size_bytes it also returns a signed upload_url and a ready curl command, for a code sandbox or agent to PUT the bytes; the file_id works once the upload is done. ChatGPT users can just pass the attached file to any tool instead.
name: upload_file

max_mb.description: The same limit in MB as FynePDF states it: say this one.

title: Upload a file
